tasks.name: reaches_self
tasks.statement: {α : Type} (f : α → α) (one : α) : Reaches f one one

tasks.name: iterate_commute
tasks.statement: {α : Type} (f : α → α) (n : Nat) (x : α) : iterate f n (f x) = f (iterate f n x)

tasks.name: reaches_predecessor
tasks.statement: {α : Type} (f : α → α) (one x : α) (hx : Reaches f one (f x)) : Reaches f one x
